items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Who they had out there but Mud Carey, Wade Whaley, and a little fella called Mack Hill... Walter Deku didn't read and he just played like he wanted... I take the job a week this place.

ctx.x: No, first I was supposed to meet Joe in Chicago and join him, you know. Yeah. They'll get back together. And I heard about this good climate out here, you see. And I changed my mind and I came to Los Angeles. And when I was here, Joe, I told him I didn't know whether I was going to stay or not, so he wired me ticket to stay in the office a whole month. But then still I didn't make up my mind. And by the time I made up my mind that I wasn't going to Chicago, I sent, I wrote the manual and I asked manual one editor…

I'll tell you how it was. No, let me tell you how it was. I'll foreseeing and tell you how it was. Yes, go ahead. Well, after they backed out, I went out. I had the tickets in my pocket. My brothers, I'm so worried. I'm going to say, well, wait a while. I said, I promised to go out with the boy and I got the tickets. She said, well, wait a while. I'll wait a while. Well, on a Sunday morning, about 4 o'clock, 4.30 in the morning, who comes to my house, 3.31 L. Street, damn. Knocked me out that night. But Walter…
She won't bother anything. She won't bother anything. Let her play. I won't hurt anything.
